verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections as plain text files with native Git integration (init, diff, pull, commit) giving version history and rollback via standard Git workflows, and this is corroborated by community users who value the git-based collaboration. However, this is really 'automations are versionable via Git' rather than a built-in review/rollback UI specific to automations (e.g., no dedicated diff-review workflow for test/automation runs, no automation-specific audit trail or approval flow). missing for 10: dedicated review workflow for automation runs (not just file diffs), built-in rollback mechanism beyond generic git revert, and independent verification of these workflows in practice.
